title: Double Picking Protocol for Tracking
author: Priota Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yb2fsqe

steps.title: Prepare and seed imaging plates
steps.instruction: Prepare low‑peptone NGM and pour onto 35 mm imaging plates; store plates in a cold room for at least 2 days; seed each plate with 50 µL freshly made 1:10 OP50:M9 solution the day before recording; leave plates on the bench to dry with lids on overnight.

substeps.instruction: Pour NGM onto 35 mm imaging plates.
Place plates in a cold room (≥2 days).
Seed each plate with 50 µL 1:10 OP50:M9 solution (freshly made) the day before recording.
Leave plates on bench to dry with lids on overnight.

steps.title: Transfer L4 worms and incubate
steps.instruction: Using a hair pick, transfer approximately 45 L4‑stage worms from maintenance plates (mixed population) onto the seeded NGM plate; then incubate the plate at 20 °C for about 24 hours.

substeps.instruction: Pick ~45 L4 worms with a hair pick onto the seeded NGM plate.
Incubate the plate at 20 °C for ~24 h.

steps.title: Add young adults and record
steps.instruction: Using a hair pick, place 5 young‑adult worms onto the seeded imaging plate; position the plate on the tracker agar side up with the lid off; wait 30 min for acclimatization; record worm behavior for 15 min (see detailed tracking instructions).

substeps.instruction: Pick 5 young‑adult worms onto the seeded imaging plate.
Place plate on the tracker, agar side up, lid off.
Wait 30 min for worms to acclimatise.
Record for 15 min (refer to imaging protocol for details).
